identity.title: Davis-Besse Nuclear Power Station, Unit 1 Docket Number 50-346, License Number NPF-3 Licensee Event Report 2025-002-00

cause.proximate_text: The cause of the unit not reaching Mode 4 in the time required by the TS was use of the incorrect procedure for the cooldown...The operators did not route to procedure DB-OP-02543, Rapid Cooldown, which was specifically written to conduct a TS required cooldown to Mode 4 or 5...The Rapid Shutdown Procedure did not clearly specify to route to the Rapid Cooldown Procedure for a short duration evolution such as a TS Required cooldown.
cause.theme: procedure-routing / mindset error during TS-required cooldown

SG 1 Startup Range Level Transmitter SP9B8
SG 1 Startup Range Level Transmitter SP9B9
Steam leak on instrument reference leg piping
nodes.description: Steam leak on the instrument reference leg piping caused SFRCS SG 1 level instruments SP9B8 and SP9B9 to be declared inoperable, entering TS LCO 3.3.11.

nodes.display_name: Operators did not route to Rapid Cooldown procedure
nodes.description: After completing the TS-required plant shutdown to Mode 3, Control Room operators continued following the Power Operations Procedure (mindset for a planned-outage shutdown) instead of routing to Rapid Cooldown procedure DB-OP-02543 specifically written for a TS required cooldown.

nodes.display_name: Additional time spent establishing RCS boron concentration
nodes.description: Following the wrong procedure path, operators spent additional time establishing the required RCS boron concentration for a one percent shutdown margin at 300 degrees instead of crediting minimum transient poisons from the rapid shutdown, delaying the cooldown to Mode 4.

nodes.display_name: Mode 4 not attained within required 12-hour TS completion time
nodes.duration: 3:15 over the 12-hour limit (14:54 total elapsed vs 12:00 required, due 0400 on 8/13)

chain: steam leak on SFRCS SG1 instrument reference leg piping [prior LER 2025-001] -> TS LCO 3.3.11 entered, required shutdown -> operators did not route to Rapid Cooldown procedure DB-OP-02543 [cause TBD] -> extra time spent establishing RCS boron concentration instead of crediting transient poisons -> Mode 4 not attained within 12-hour TS completion time (exceeded by 3h15m)
notes: Official cause_code is TBD/provisional per FORM-366 fields, despite narrative clearly describing a personnel/procedure-use error; category left as 'provisional' per rule 4. Auxiliary Feedwater System [BA] and analysis-of-event SFRCS logic-channel redundancy discussion are design/safety-analysis context (no loss of safety function) - not modeled as an operable backup with BACKED_UP_BY since AFW was not itself inoperable or substituting for a failed system in this event chain; the actual consequence being modeled is the late Mode 4 entry, not an ECCS/AFW unavailability. Previous similar event: narrative states no LERs at DBNPS in past three years related to TS required cooldowns, so no stub SIMILAR_TO LER for that comparison; however LER 2025-001 is referenced multiple times as directly related (same steam leak precipitating event) and is modeled as a stub with SIMILAR_TO edge per rule 9.
